messages:
amy_ceo: Thanks again everyone for joining the all-hands — there were a few security/compliance follow-ups I promised I'd surface here. I'll drop the ones I remember and can you chime in?

jordan_security: yep, thanks. quick list would help. i'm adding bullets as i see them from the Q&A notes.

amy_ceo: First: SOC2 evidence access — engineering asked whether they can pull the evidence bundle for customer audits themselves or if compliance will serve it. what's the plan?

jordan_security: short answer: compliance will curate the canonical evidence bundle for auditors (so we control scope). but teams will get a read-only export of logs/artefacts related to their product area. goal: reduce duplicate pulls and maintain a single source of truth.

sam_pm: can we get a small checklist that product teams can follow so they know what to hand off to compliance before an audit? e.g., config versions, infra diagrams, runbooks

nadia_compliance: yes — creating a checklist doc this week. will include: infra diagrams, access lists, change history (git tags), key rotation records, and high-level risk assessments. will post link in #docs when ready.

amy_ceo: KMS/BYOQ question: customers asked about HSM-backed keys and whether we support BYOK with an HSM attestation.

jordan_security: currently we support BYOK via our KMS integration and bring-your-own-key via wrapped key material. HSM-backed customer-managed keys (with remote attestation) are on the roadmap but not GA. timeline: prototype hsm connector in Q3, pilot with 1 customer in Q4.

maya_infra: to add — for Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS endpoints (bring your own key material) today, but the on-prem HSM plugin is separate work (drivers + attestation flow).

ryan_eng: any impact on the runtime if a customer uses BYO-KMS? does the runtime call out to their KMS synchronously?

jordan_security: we do async local envelope encryption in most paths. runtime only calls KMS for key unwrap during initialize/rotation; normal token-serving hot path uses cached DEKs to avoid per-request KMS latency.

sam_pm: audit logs / retention: several product teams asked if customers can opt to stream raw audit logs to their own S3 (for e-discovery and retention). status?

jordan_security: yes — streaming to customer-owned S3 and to SIEM via syslog/Kinesis is supported for Dedicated and Private. Hosted customers will get exported bundles and a streaming export beta for enterprise plans next quarter. retention defaults: 90 days for detailed logs, 365 days for aggregated metrics; configurable per contract.

ryan_eng: is the audit log format stable? teams want to build parsers.

jordan_security: v1 is stable and will be backward-compatible for at least one major version. sample payload in the docs (logs include request_id, model, route, token_count, user_id_hash).

amy_ceo: ISO27001 rundown — someone asked when we'll start the ISO cycle.

nadia_compliance: kickoff planned for next month. we'll sync controls we covered in SOC2 to speed up ISO mapping. target: certificate within 9 months if no major gaps.

maya_infra: tiny ops question from the thread: for customers using VPC/private control plane, are we supporting VPC endpoints (AWS) or requiring VPN/peering?

jordan_security: we support both. options: managed VPC peering (for Dedicated) or PrivateLink endpoints (regional) for Hosted-private traffic. choice depends on customer's network constraints; we'll document network diagrams for both in the private-deploy handbook.

sam_pm: can we get owners for each follow-up so we can track in the all-hands action items?

jordan_security: i'll own the SOC2 evidence access model and KMS roadmap comms. nadia_compliance will own the auditor checklist and ISO timeline. maya_infra will own the VPC/network docs and the HSM infra prototype coordination. sam_pm — can you track these in the all-hands follow-ups doc?

sam_pm: yep i'll create an issue and assign owners + due dates. planning to send the follow-up email by EOD tomorrow.

ryan_eng: small ask — can security share the sample KMS policy we recommend for customer managed keys? will help infra teams.

jordan_security: posted minimal example below for now — will add to docs properly: 
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE-KEY-ID","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodRuntimeRole"}}]}
```

nadia_compliance: tiny reminder — if teams start exporting logs to customer S3, include a short README with the retention policy, encryption status, and contact for subpoenas. auditors always ask where the chain of custody is.

amy_ceo: awesome, thanks. please post the checklist and the VPC/network diagrams into #docs and ping me once everything is linked from the all-hands follow-ups doc. :raised_hands:
